name: COMPONENT_SCOPE
notes: E1.33 Section 7.6.2. Devices and Brokers only support Scope Slot 1. In a SET an empty Scope String removes the Scope.

get_response.name: scope
get_response.notes: Fixed 63 octet field: UTF-8 string of 1 to 62 octets, terminated and padded with null characters. The empty string is not a valid Scope; E133_DEFAULT_SCOPE is "default".

get_response.name: static_broker_ipv4_address
get_response.notes: 0.0.0.0 unless the Static Config Type is STATIC_CONFIG_IPV4.

get_response.name: static_broker_ipv6_address
get_response.notes: :: (all zero) unless the Static Config Type is STATIC_CONFIG_IPV6.

get_response.name: static_broker_port
get_response.notes: 0 if no static configuration is present.
